title: Pluvial
summary: PLU'VIAL PLUVIAM'ETER, noun [Latin pluvia, rain, and Gr.measure.] A rain gage, an instrument for ascertaining the quantity of water that falls in rain, or in rain and snow, in any particular climate o

inlines.v: PLU'VIAL PLUVIAM'ETER, noun [Latin pluvia, rain, and Gr.measure.] A rain gage, an instrument for ascertaining the quantity of water that falls in rain, or in rain and snow, in any particular climate or place.
